comment: Female atlas configuration. Element ids are BodyParts3D 4.0 (FJxxxx). See DECISIONS.md.

male_only.FJ3148: Urethra (male: prostatic, membranous and spongy parts)
male_only.FJ3426: Left superficial dorsal vein of penis
male_only.FJ3637: Right superficial dorsal vein of penis
male_only.FJ2815: Pubic hair (male distribution, follows the scrotal surface)

FJ3149.reason: Female urinary bladder from HRA (scan-derived, female relations to uterus and vagina).

pelvis_morph.comment: Landmark targets as multipliers of each landmark's distance from the midsagittal plane (x), plus explicit shifts. Acetabula and the sacral base stay fixed so the femoral heads and L5 still articulate. Values are chosen to move male BodyParts3D measures toward published female means; see DECISIONS.md and DATA_SOURCES.md.

stature.comment: Uniform scale for all shared BodyParts3D structures: HRA female skin height / BodyParts3D skin height (computed at build time).
